result.title: FANO: Anchored Forward-Noise Optimization for Diffusion Inverse Problems
result.comment: 26 pages, 9 figures, 8 tables. Preprint, under review
result.summary: Pre-trained diffusion models have become a widely adopted zero-shot prior for image inverse problems, among which annealed decoupling methods achieve leading reconstruction performance on nonlinear tasks. We find, however, that annealed methods that directly optimize the denoiser input $x_t$ exhibit radial drift in later layers: within-layer optimization drives the noise-component norm of $x_t$ away from its typical value, pushing the denoiser out of its high-performance regime and degrading reconstruction quality. To address this, we propose FANO (Anchored Forward-Noise Optimization). At each annealing layer, FANO fixes the previous denoiser estimate as an anchor and optimizes only the forward noise $e$, whose distribution is known, instead of $x_t$, thereby preserving the forward-diffusion structure of the denoiser input. The standard Gaussian prior on $e$ concentrates its norm near the typical value, and deviations degrade denoiser performance. We accordingly decompose $e$ in polar coordinates into a direction and a radial magnitude, and apply a soft potential to regulate the radius, keeping $x_t$ in the high-density region of the forward distribution. On multiple linear and nonlinear inverse problems, FANO matches the strongest current baselines on linear tasks and achieves consistent improvements on nonlinear tasks.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究扩散模型求解图像逆问题时，退火解耦方法直接优化去噪器输入 x_t 会导致噪声分量范数的径向漂移，提出 FANO：以前一层去噪估计为锚点，只优化分布已知的前向噪声 e，并在极坐标下用软势约束其半径。
AI.relevance_reason: 「对 latent 反复优化会使其范数偏离典型值、把模型推离高性能区」这一观察，可能可供核查 latent 推理中多步状态更新的分布漂移与状态范数约束；但论文面向图像重建，与 VLM 推理本身无直接联系。
